headword: {少年時代|しょうねんじだい}

definitions.explanation: The period of a person's life from later childhood into the early teens, looked back on as a stage. Strictly it refers to a boy's youth, but it is also used loosely for childhood in general, especially in reminiscence and biography.

examples.japanese: {少年時代|しょうねんじだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少年時代|しょうねんじだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: My father spent his boyhood in Hokkaido.

examples.english: He says that a single book he read in boyhood determined the rest of his life.

notes:
⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧ (boy, youth) + ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (era, period of life). The pattern noun + ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ is productive for life stages: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (student days), ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (childhood).
